$description:
| What does this do? | Blocks the authentication transfer flow so users cannot transfer an existing sign-in session to another client in a way that bypasses your controls. |
| Why should you use this? | Reduces risk from token/session transfer abuse and helps ensure each client completes its own authentication. |
| What is the end-user impact? | Users cannot use authentication transfer between clients where this flow would apply; excluded break-glass and designated admin accounts remain usable for recovery. |
| Learn more | [Authentication flows in Conditional Access](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/concept-authentication-flows) |
